description: Search FDA FOOD recall / enforcement reports (openFDA /food/enforcement) — product recalls, reasons, classification, recalling firm, distribution, and status. Use for food-safety / recall-history questions (distinct from fda_drug_recalls which covers drugs).

query.description: OpenFDA search query (optional — omit for most recent recalls). Examples: 'reason_for_recall:"Listeria"', 'state:"CA"', 'classification:"Class I"'.

skip.description: Pagination offset (default 0) — the reported total can exceed one page of 100.

name: fda_food_recalls
title: Fda Food Recalls
